name: Pravo na schastye
source:
What would you do if you got a chance to live everything over again?

Denis arrives at Sovyonok and, for the first time in a long while, feels like he belongs. He makes friends, grows close to Lena, and gradually begins to believe that things can actually work out for him here. Yet sometimes someone says a phrase he has already heard before, or an ordinary evening at the camp suddenly reminds him of the person he has been trying to forget.

This is a personal story about first love and how hard it is to let go of the past when it feels like it can still be fixed. Lena plays a key role in it.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3332388944]Steam[/url]]
